svg.text: MEMBER COORDINATION DRAWING - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
Units: mm. All members are centreline/reference diagrams, without section thickness.
Exterior envelope: 7200 x 6000; maximum roof height 2800 above outdoor ground.
Structural axes were provisionally placed on the outline for layout; offsets remain TBD.
H is symbolic. Elevation vertical scale is schematic; do not measure H from this file.
Opening heights are relative to finished floor; the finished-floor elevation is TBD.
Column base/top, beam depth, roof layers and wall top are unresolved.
Reference spans are NOT fabrication / cutting lengths. All cut lengths remain TBD.
All section types, widths, depths, thicknesses, grades and panel spacing need design.
Q355B primary / Q235B or Q355B secondary are candidates only.
Bracing, connections, bolts, welds, anchors and foundations require a complete design.
No capacity calculation or stability verification is included. No procurement quantities.
Roof drainage is outside this drawing; roof system and resulting loads still need design.
Z columns; L transverse main beams; X longitudinal ties; P roof secondary members.
S/N/E/W wall members. Column tags repeated in elevations refer to the same columns.
Each physical draft member has one schedule row. See members.csv / members.json.
MEMBER GROUPS / SECTIONS AND CUT LENGTHS: TBD
Z01 - Z08: Columns, 8 diagram members; section TBD.
L01 - L04: Main beams, 4 diagram members; section TBD.
X01 - X06: Longitudinal ties, 6 diagram members; section TBD.
P01 - P27: Roof secondaries, 27 diagram members; section TBD.
S01 - S25: South wall, 25 diagram members; section TBD.
N01 - N15: North wall, 15 diagram members; section TBD.
E01 - E18: East wall, 18 diagram members; section TBD.
W01 - W15: West wall, 15 diagram members; section TBD.
DIRECT-ON-SOIL SUPPORT RESTRICTED; FLOOR / BASE NOT DESIGNED. SEE FLOOR SHEET.
